blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A female household worker, who claimed to have been a victim of the ‘dugo-dugo’ scheme, was arrested in Makati City for allegedly stealing jewelry worth P1.7 million. According to the National Capital Region Police Office, the housemaid initially denied involvement and claimed she was a victim of a dugo-dugo scheme. The theft tactic targets helpers or family members by manipulating them into handing over cash and valuables under the pretense of an emergency.
